abstract: Radiation-induced cavernous malformations (RICMs) are most commonly reported in young patients who have previously received radiotherapy. Here, we report a case of a patient with a germ cell tumor who was treated with whole brain radiotherapy (WBRT) and then incidentally found to have numerous RICMs. A 31-year-old male visited the hospital for a testicular mass. On examination, he was diagnosed with a mixed germ cell tumor with lung/brain metastases. The patient underwent a left orchiectomy and received 4 cycles of chemotherapy. He was then treated with WBRT for residual lesions in the brain and a wedge resection for the lung metastasis. Four years later, approximately 250-300 RICMs were incidentally observed in a follow-up brain image. Because the patient had not noticed any symptoms and the RICMs were small in size, he was not treated. To our knowledge, this is the first reported case of numerous (approximately 250-300) RICMs in a germ cell tumor patient after WBRT. Herein, we report details of this case and discuss the typical clinical features of RICM.
abstract_ja: 放射線誘発性海綿状血管腫（RICM）は、以前に放射線療法を受けた若年患者で最も多く報告されている。ここでは、全脳放射線療法（WBRT）を受けた後に、多発性RICMを偶発的に認めた胚細胞腫瘍患者の症例を報告する。31歳の男性が精巣腫瘤を主訴に受診した。診察の結果、肺および脳転移を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。患者は左精巣摘除術を受け、4コースの化学療法を施行された。その後、脳の残存病変に対してWBRTを、肺転移に対して楔状切除を施行された。4年後、経過観察の脳画像検査で約250～300個のRICMが偶発的に認められた。患者は症状を自覚しておらず、RICMは小さかったため、治療は行われなかった。我々の知る限り、WBRT後の胚細胞腫瘍患者における多数（約250～300個）のRICMの報告は初めてである。本症例の詳細を報告するとともに、RICMの典型的な臨床的特徴について考察する。
